recipe: Reference clone ref/faker (git worktree of it during the build). A virtual environment .venv/ in ref/faker holds the third-party test dependencies only, as in bench/set/environments/bench-py.json: python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install tzdata freezegun "pytest>=6.0.1" "python-stdnum>=1.20" "ukpostcodeparser>=1.1.1" "validators>=0.13.0" pillow xmltodict (Python 3.13.9, pytest 9.2.0). Faker itself is NOT installed (neither regular nor editable); it loads from the repository root because the test command is python -m pytest. PYTHONPATH, PYTHONHOME, PYTEST_ADDOPTS and PYTEST_PLUGINS unset. Linters were run from a separate virtual environment outside the repository: flake8 7.5.0 + flake8-comprehensions 3.17.0, isort 9.0.2, black 24.4.0, mypy 1.15.0 (commands of tox.ini; PYTHONUTF8=1 for isort on Windows).
